recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future specialty modeling changes should be handled through new PA tracker decisions rather than reviving the removed Practitioner extension.
issue_request: FHIR-13786 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification PA request to remove the Practitioner classification extension because PractitionerRole.specialty covers the organization/location-specific specialty concept.
initial_application: Git commit 78b39f30cd applied the tracker by changing the Practitioner extension spreadsheet row from classification to !classification and adding a note that practitioner role specialty provides this detail. The old spreadsheet was later removed during the R4B source refactor.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists practitioner and practitionerrole as active resources. Current source has no active practitioner-classification definition; matching old extension material remains only in tools/history release archives. The FHIR Extension Pack checkout also has no practitioner-classification definition. Later PA issues FHIR-25033 and FHIR-32497 further clarified the PractitionerRole.specialty and Practitioner.qualification distinction and are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No current source edit is needed because the active specification already reflects FHIR-13786 and editing historical release archives or adding redundant prose would not improve the current build.
